title: Community
subtitle: In a lonely, fractured culture, Jesus offers a new kind of family.

hero.note: The practice's own looping header from practicingtheway.org/community. Muted, no controls, decorative.

playlist.title: The Community sessions
playlist.note: Plays the series in order. Use the playlist button in the player to jump between sessions.

intro: Despite the unprecedented connectivity of the modern era, genuine community is vanishing. Isolation, transience, and superficiality can sabotage our formation into people of mature love. But through Jesus, we enter a new kind of family that offers intimacy, joy, healing, and commitment.

Each Practice comes with four session videos, weekly exercises and readings, and additional resources to help your group create life-changing daily rhythms as you apprentice under Jesus together. The sessions are about 30 minutes long and include time for group discussion at the beginning.

Our Practices are perfect to use with small groups or to run course-style with a larger group, but they can also be modified for a churchwide Sunday teaching series, small cohorts, and many other contexts.

sessions.title: Be Family Around a Table
teaching: To apprentice under Jesus is to join a new kind of family – a highly relational, joyfully-connected kinship group that follows Jesus together – not just around a stage, but around a table.
sessions.practice: Begin eating a meal with your group weekly.

sessions.title: Share Your Joys and Sorrows
teaching: In an individualistic culture prone to despair, followers of Jesus form micro-communities of defiant joy that resist the black hole of fear and anger, and mutually carry burdens of sorrow and pain.
sessions.practice: Go around the table and share the highs and lows of the week.

sessions.title: Confess Your Sins
teaching: Many modern barriers to community are symptoms of shame. But as we learn to courageously name our wickedness and woundedness in the presence of loving community, we begin to heal.
sessions.practice: Find a trusted person and confess your sin.

sessions.title: Stay Together to Grow
teaching: As we draw closer in community, periods of conflict, pain, and disillusionment are inevitable. But as we accept these challenges and remain connected, we grow into mature love together.
sessions.practice: Spend time in a guided reflection to clarify your next steps.

resources.title: The Companion Guide
body: Each session will use the Community Practice Companion Guide, which contains weekly Reach Exercises, assigned readings and podcast episodes, and reflection questions.

resources.title: Recommended Reading
body: The recommended reading for the Community Practice is Made to Belong: Five Practices for Cultivating Community in a Disconnected World by David Kim.

link.label: Made to Belong, by David Kim

resources.title: Table Conversations
body: Table Conversations is a set of cards with questions to help your community go beyond the surface and connect in meaningful (and fun) ways.

resources.title: The Table
body: The Table is a collection of 10 delicious recipes for your community gatherings, with clear divisions of labor to help make meals a simpler, more communal affair. Download your copy.

resources.title: Rule of Life Podcast
body: The Community season of the Rule of Life podcast will feature pastor, writer, and disability advocate Shelbi Schutt in conversation with John Mark Comer. This season includes luminary interviews with Andy Crouch, Jay and Danielle Pathak, Dr. Curt Thompson, and David Kim, plus additional testimonials and stories unpacking what it means to live in the new family of Jesus.

flags.detail: practicingtheway.org/community carries no session videos. Its videos are all muted, autoplaying, looping background art: the practice header mp4 used here as the hero, plus the site-wide loop 1046530705 and further decorative embeds. Both "Run Practice" and "Preview Session 01" link to launch.practicingtheway.org/signup, so the real session videos sit behind their signup. The playlist player above the sessions is what people watch until per-session ids are filled in.

Left out of the data: purchase clauses trimmed from paragraphs that were otherwise kept, and any product-only or seasonal block. Assigned reading was kept, with its link, because the Companion Guide assigns it week by week.

Left out: the seasonal "Summer is a state of mind" / Summer Slowdown block, same as on Sabbath. The Companion Guide paragraph on this page is written twice in slightly different words; the duplicate was dropped.

Built from a saved copy of the page rather than a pipeline run, so no video ids were fetched. Re-running `npm run practices -- --write community` refreshes the videos and preserves subtitle, hero, playlist and resources.
